newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL SENATE TO QUIZ CENTRAL BANK NOMINEE FRANCO.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL SENATE TO QUIZ CENTRAL BANK NOMINEE FRANCO.

text.p: Brazilian senators were due to quiz Gustavo Franco, nominated as the new Central Bank president, Thursday, a Senate official said.
The official of the Senate Economic Affairs Committee said the hearing was due to start at 1100 local/1400 GMT.
Newspapers reported that senators were expected to approve the nomination of Franco, currently director of international affairs.
After the committee, Franco faces a vote on the Senate floor.
Franco replaces Gustavo Loyola, who announced his resignation last week citing personal reasons.
Franco's successor as international affairs director, as well as a successor for Director of Controls Alkimar Moura, who has also chosen to resign, have yet to be named.
